answer: Agents earn trust through a beacon that samples attested actions across many independent harnesses, rewarding agreement within a small delta of tolerance. To spawn a credible clone, an attacker must replicate genuine outputs from diverse, independently operated harnesses and post a refundable bridge bond, slashed on any divergence the sampler detects. Because each additional verified harness raises the price geometrically, fake identities cost more to sustain than the work they mimic.
